title: Ardente v. Horan — conditional land acceptance
shortTitle: Ardente v. Horan — conditional land acceptance
summary: A signed return accompanied by a condition about furnishings operated as a counteroffer.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

The prospective buyer sought confirmation that items such as dining and porch furniture were included. The court denied specific performance because the response was conditional. The book asks whether the same wording could have been read as an unqualified acceptance accompanied by a mere request.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 269–270. Open assigned page 269.
